title: Quantitative Developer Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Quantitative Developer.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas Across Levels
lines: 1. Ultra-Low Latency & High Performance: Modern C++ (C++20/23), memory layout, CPU cache lines (L1/L2/L3), branch prediction, lock-free queues, and SIMD vectorization.
2. Market Data & Order Execution: FIX protocol, ITCH/OUCH binary feeds, exchange matching engine interaction, order book state reconstruction, and ring buffers.
3. Concurrency & Operating System Tuning: Kernel bypass (Solarflare OpenOnload, DPDK), thread pinning, isolcpus, interrupt affinity, and timestamping (RDTSC/PTP).
4. Strategy Implementation: Translating quantitative alpha models into deterministic, sub-microsecond production execution engines.
